{"id":1603899881,"question_id":2998,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1744394778,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"67 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1603899881/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"  Count Symmetric Integers","memory":"9.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countSymmetricIntegers(int low, int high) {\n        int ans=0;\n        \n        for(int i = low ; i<= high ; i++)\n        {\n            string st = to_string(i);\n            int len = st.size();\n\n            if(len & 1) continue;\n\n            int left_sum = 0;\n            int right_sum = 0;\n\n            for(int i = 0 ; i <len/2 ; i++)\n            {\n                left_sum += (char)st[i];\n            }\n\n            for(int i = len/2 ; i<len ; i++)\n            {\n                right_sum += (char)st[i];\n            }\n\n            if(left_sum == right_sum) ans++;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-symmetric-integers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":547}
